just_mas0: Nils Mas arrived with the Day 5 draft, carrying a letter he never sent and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Nils Mas ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
phs_jrotc_drill_team: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Team why he came. Nobody in S-S9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A direct hit on the trench at S-S9. Emil "Mud" Team was the only one they could still help, and only just. Emil "Mud" Team died at his post at S-S9 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.
Florian Team took the same post at S-S9 where Emil "Mud" Team stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
